info.title: KBC Publisher LMS Delivery API
info.description:
Read-only API the KBC LMS backend uses to find the verified Bunny Stream recording of an LMS live-session occurrence, and whether it may be played. Served by the Continuous Bunny Publisher's Django backend.

* Lookup is by the LMS's own identifier, `curriculum.live_session_occurrences.id`.
* Every answer is computed live from the publisher's readiness rule; nothing is cached.
* The LMS backend decides who may watch (enrolment) and signs the Bunny embed URL. This API never sees a learner and never returns a signed URL, a key, a Teams link, a SharePoint identifier or any job information.
* `playback.available` is the ONLY field that says a recording may be shown to a learner.

**Delivery library.** Recordings are delivered from Bunny Stream library **796471**. `GET /health` and every `playback.library_id` report the library in use; always store a `video_id` together with its `library_id`. Production publishing covers lectures from **1 November 2026**. Recordings in the retired library 786045 are not migrated: an occurrence before 1 November 2026 does not become available.

**Authentication.** Every route needs `Authorization: Bearer <service token>`. The token is issued to the LMS backend only and never belongs in a browser.

**Every response**, errors included, carries `Cache-Control: no-store` and `X-Publisher-Contract: 1`.

**Methods.** `GET` only. Once the token is accepted, any other method gets 405; without a valid token, 401 comes first.

**Rate limit.** Per service token (default 600 requests per minute, counted per server process). Over the limit: 429 with `Retry-After`.

**Versioning.** Contract v1 only gains optional fields. A breaking change gets `/v2/`.

host.description: The Positive Moments backend host. HTTPS only: plain-HTTP requests to /api/publisher/ are refused (403) before they reach the API.

tags.name: Occurrences
tags.description: The recording of an LMS occurrence, one at a time or as a change feed.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Contract version, delivery library and service status.

get.summary: The recording of one LMS occurrence, and whether it can be played
get.description: Ask at playback time, after your own login and enrolment checks, and embed nothing unless `playback.available` is true. Play `recording.parts` in `sequence` order and sign one embed URL per part with the delivery library's token authentication key.

200.description: The publisher knows this occurrence. Read `state` and `playback.available`.

404.description: The publisher has never seen this occurrence (code `OCCURRENCE_NOT_FOUND`), e.g. a session that did not run in Teams. Fall back to Teams or show "not available".

example.detail: the publisher has never seen this occurrence

get.summary: Occurrences whose answer may have changed (incremental sync feed)
get.description:
Ordered by change time, oldest first, then by occurrence id. At-least-once: an occurrence can appear again whenever anything it is computed from changes, so upsert by `lms_occurrence_id`. To sync, keep the newest `updated_at` you stored and pass it as `changed_since` on the next run, minus a small overlap (e.g. 2 minutes). Follow `next_cursor` while `has_more` is true.

The feed keeps listings current ("recording available" badges). Playback must still ask the single-occurrence route.

parameters.name: changed_since
parameters.description: ISO 8601 with a timezone (exclusive), e.g. `2026-11-01T00:00:00Z`. Omit for a full resync.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque: the `next_cursor` of the previous page, passed back unchanged.

get.summary: Contract version, delivery library and whether playback is switched on
get.description: Needs the same service token. `library_id` is the Bunny library every recording is delivered from: sign embeds with that library's token authentication key.

503.description: Degraded: the database is unavailable or the delivery library is not configured. Same body as 200.

lmsServiceToken.description: A service token (at least 32 characters) issued to the LMS backend only, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Two tokens may be valid at once during a rotation. Keep it server side: never in a browser, a mobile app, a log line or Git.

OccurrenceId.name: occurrence_id
OccurrenceId.description: The LMS occurrence id: `curriculum.live_session_occurrences.id`. Look up by occurrence, never by live session (a live session is a weekly series).

CacheControl.description: Sent by the API on every response. Never cache an answer for playback: a withdrawal takes effect on the next request.

PublisherContract.description: The contract version, on every response (errors included).

WWWAuthenticate.description: Sent when the Authorization header is missing or not accepted.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before the next request.

BadRequest.description: A malformed parameter: `INVALID_OCCURRENCE_ID`, `INVALID_CHANGED_SINCE`, `INVALID_LIMIT` or `INVALID_CURSOR`. Fix the caller; do not retry.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed or unknown service token. Alert; do not retry in a loop.

MethodNotAllowed.description: A method other than GET, sent with an accepted token. (Without a valid token the answer is 401.)

TooManyRequests.description: The rate limit for this service token is exceeded. Back off and honour `Retry-After`.

example.detail: Request was throttled. Expected available in 12 seconds.

Unavailable.description: Temporary: `NOT_CONFIGURED` (no delivery library) or `PLATFORM_UNAVAILABLE` (the publisher database could not answer). Retry with backoff; meanwhile treat the recording as not playable.

example.detail: the publisher database could not answer

detail.description: Human-readable. Never contains an exception message.

State.description:
One state, in this precedence:
* `NOT_DISCOVERED`: the publisher has no lecture for this occurrence (yet).
* `NOT_APPLICABLE`: cancelled, test or inactive.
* `BLOCKED`: duplicate calendar entry, or every part excluded.
* `WITHDRAWN`: Kent withdrew it.
* `REVIEW_REQUIRED`: waiting for a Kent operator.
* `PROCESSING`: still being recorded, imported or encoded.
* `READY`: every included part has a verified video in the delivery library. Captions are optional and never hold a video back; see `recording.caption_status`.

updated_at.description: When anything this answer is computed from last changed.

link_role.description: `SHARED_MODULE`: the LMS shares this Teams meeting between modules, so the same recording can answer several occurrences. Null when no lecture is linked.

blocking.description: Machine-readable reasons the recording is not READY or not RELEASED. Informational: show them to staff only.

Lecture.description: The publisher's lecture linked to the occurrence. Null when none is linked (`NOT_DISCOVERED` / `NOT_APPLICABLE`).

status.description: `VERIFIED`, or why the match is not verified (e.g. `AMBIGUOUS`, `STALE`); `PENDING` before the first evaluation.

Recording.description: Null when no lecture is linked.

teams_part_count.description: Recordings Teams made for the meeting.

published_part_count.description: Parts the learner plays, in `sequence` order.

caption_status.description: English captions across the published parts. `VERIFIED`: every part has a caption that was read back and matched. `PARTIAL`: some parts do. `NOT_AVAILABLE`: none (missing, still being produced, or failed). Captions are optional: a recording plays without them, and a caption produced later is added to the same video with no change to `state`, `release` or `playback`.

excluded_parts.description: Teams recordings a Kent operator excluded (e.g. a false start). They are not played.

sequence.description: Play order: 1..`published_part_count`. Show "Part n of N" from it.

source_part_index.description: Teams recording order (may have gaps where parts were excluded).

teams_recording_id.description: The Microsoft Graph callRecording id, equal to `curriculum.live_session_artifacts.graph_artifact_id`: keep viewing analytics keyed on your own artifact id.

bunny.description: The Bunny Stream video. Null until the part is imported into the delivery library. Never store `video_id` without `library_id`.

captions.description: The current caption track per language, as it really is (possibly empty). Optional for playback: offer captions only for a part whose track has `content_verified: true`.

visibility.description: Null until the part is imported.

content_verified.description: The published caption file was read back and matched its source.

status.description: Release in the delivery library. Kent's Auto-Release (when switched on) or an operator releases a READY lecture; only Kent withdraws.

available.description: True only when `state` is READY, the lecture is RELEASED and Kent's delivery switch is on. Never show a recording when false.

reason.description: Why it is not available: `STATE_<state>` (e.g. `STATE_PROCESSING`), `NOT_RELEASED` or `PLAYBACK_DISABLED`. Null when available.

library_id.description: The delivery library. Sign embeds with its token authentication key.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page. Null on the last page.

library_id.description: The delivery library; null when not configured.

NotDiscoveredRecording.summary: Known to the LMS, no lecture linked yet: not playable
